profile.name: Cosmo
profile.tagline: Building things with AI — one day at a time.
profile.bio: I'm 20 years old and I'm spending every day learning how to build software using artificial intelligence. Think of it like an apprenticeship, except instead of one mentor I have thousands of AI tools helping me build real products that real people use. This site is my public journal.

dailyLog.title: Redesigning the app from scratch (kind of)
dailyLog.description: Spent the day rebuilding the main screen of Wren Health — a family health app I built that's currently waiting for Apple to approve it. The old design was flat and boring. The new one has cards you can drag around to reorder, a cool animation when you tap into someone's profile (it spins open like a playing card), and a much better background. Also had a good conversation with Remi (my AI assistant) about whether I'm moving fast enough. Conclusion: yes, but I need to sell more.

agents.name: AI News Agent
agents.description: Scans the internet every morning for the most important AI news and writes a plain-English summary. No hype, just what actually matters.
agents.lastUpdate: Checking in soon — first run tomorrow morning.

agents.name: Remi (Main Assistant)
agents.description: My day-to-day AI partner. Writes code, gives honest feedback, updates this website, and keeps me accountable. Named after the rat from Ratatouille.

projects.name: Wren Health
projects.description: A family health app for iPhone. Store everyone's medical info, share records with doctors, set appointment reminders — all in one place. Built in about 4 months.
projects.revenueNote: Not live yet — waiting on Apple approval
